neighbours.label: the adjective ' different' / ' separate' marking that several things are distinct from one another (different X, separate Y)
fire: The museum displays paintings from different centuries in one hall.
These two files are stored on separate servers for safety.
Students come from different countries to study here.
We tried three different recipes before choosing one.
The twins sleep in separate rooms now.
The teams used different approaches to the problem.
The data were collected at different times of the year.
Keep raw meat and vegetables on separate cutting boards.
quiet: The museum displays paintings from the same century in one hall.
These two files are stored on one server for convenience.
Students come from nearby towns to study here.
We tried three new recipes before choosing one.
The twins sleep in the same room now.
The team used a clever approach to the problem.
The data were collected at night during the year.
Keep raw meat and vegetables on clean cutting boards.

notes: Output direction suppresses different/separate/distinct; - pole fires on the predicate after 'could be different'.
